Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: They designed the solution to require OAuth/Bearer authentication and added an Authorization header to en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php, which is unnecessary (and invalid) for public read access via the MediaWiki Action API. This caused mwoauth-invalid-authorization errors and blocked retrieval of revisions. Additionally, their code omitted proper continuation handling (rvcontinue), so even with a valid request it wouldn’t have counted all revisions up to June 2023 (2732).
